title: System Control Board, release 1: the unit register, routes on the Pre-flight, and Start re-testing what it depends on
why: Decision 0171 (Jason approved revision 2, 2026-11-18), release 1 of 5. The unit register (app/lib/ControlRegister.php) names each system and process: every workflow's site jobs, crawler tasks, needs, services, workers, the endpoints the workers call and the tables they write, read from what the code already declares, so a new one appears by itself. The Pre-flight gains a Routes group: each workflow's and each worker's route checked hop by hop to be there, and every endpoint claimed by a process; for now these lines hold nothing. Start the system's confirm step now tests what each workflow depends on fresh before confirming it (its services and workers when older than pf_fresh_mins, default 60 minutes; its source-map needs always), so a stale or never-run need no longer passes; it runs the four query timings once a Start (slow is noted and holds nothing, a failed query is a step on the card). SystemStart.php's header now describes how Start works today. FAQ: two entries.

log.msg: Plan approved (no switch: everyone at once when published), advancing on schedule.
